title: Bijectivity of a prescribed scalar-extension twist map on one Proj chart
statement: Let $R,S,A,B$ be commutative rings, with $R$-algebras $S,A$ and an $S$-algebra $B$. Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n$ and $B=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}B_n$ be graded rings whose pieces are $R$- and $S$-submodules, respectively. Give an $S$-algebra isomorphism $\beta:S\otimes_R A\simeq B$ and a graded ring homomorphism $\psi:A\to B$ such that $\beta(1\otimes a)=\psi(a)$ and $B_n=\operatorname{span}_S\psi(A_n)$ for every $n$. Assume $B_+\subseteq\operatorname{Ideal.map}(\psi)(A_+)$, so $r=\operatorname{Proj.map}(\psi):\operatorname{Proj}(B)\to\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ is defined [lem-nagata-affine-proj-scalar-extension]. Fix $j\in\mathbf Z$ and a morphism $\eta:r^*\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Proj}(A)}(j)\to\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Proj}(B)}(j)$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] [def-pc-module-pullback]. Suppose that for every open $U\subseteq\operatorname{Proj}(A)$, every twist section $s\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O(j))$, and every $x\in r^{-1}U$, the value $\eta(1\otimes s)(x)$ is the image of $s(r(x))$ under the ordinary localization ring map $A_{\psi^{-1}(\mathfrak p_x)}\to B_{\mathfrak p_x}$ induced by $\psi$. For every $n>0$, every $f\in A_n$ and every open $W\subseteq D_+(\psi(f))$, the map on sections $\eta_W$ is bijective. This concerns one given morphism, one degree and one standard chart; it asserts neither existence nor gluing of comparison morphisms.

proof.text: On D_+(f), identify the concrete locally-fraction twist with the quasi-coherent module of homogeneous fractions of degree j. Use the single-twist basic-open fractions theorem for its section module and restrictions. Apply the graded-module sheaf theorem to A(j), and its basis-extension uniqueness, to identify these concrete sections with the associated sheaf; repeat for B(j). Negative j uses the same shifted grading, with zero negative homogeneous pieces.

Put H=(A_f)_0 and L=(A_f)_j. The homogeneous localization comparison identifies (B_psi(f))_0 with S tensor_R H, after transporting by beta. The explicit tensor-balancing equivalence L tensor_H (S tensor_R H) -> S tensor_R L sends u tensor (s tensor h) to s tensor h*u and has inverse s tensor u -> u tensor (s tensor 1). The graded-module localization scalar-extension equivalence, transported by beta, then identifies it with (B_psi(f))_j. The composite sends (a/f^m) tensor c to c*psi(a)/psi(f)^m. The relation hgraded identifies beta on the homogeneous pieces by spanning; hbeta identifies its values on pure tensors. All maps respect localization equality, including zero divisors.

Pullback preserves quasi-coherence. On the two affine standard charts, the affine pullback-sections theorem identifies the source with the sheaf associated to L tensor_H (B_psi(f))_0. The hypothesis on eta specifies its value on every pulled-back chart section. Multiplying these by coefficients generates that tensor module, so eta on global sections is the equivalence of the previous step. The affine tilde-Gamma adjunction then identifies its restriction to the chart with an isomorphism of sheaves.

Restrict the resulting chart isomorphism further to any open W inside D_+(psi(f)). An isomorphism of sheaves is an isomorphism on every section module, hence eta.app W is bijective. If the chart or W is empty, both section modules are zero and the same argument applies.

theorem scalarExtension_twistMap_basicOpen_bijective
    {R S A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R A] [Algebra S B]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → Submodule R A) (ℬ : ℕ → Submodule S B)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (β : TensorProduct R S A ≃ₐ[S] B) (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hβψ : ∀ a : A, β (TensorProduct.tmul R (1 : S) a) = ψ a)
    (hgraded : ∀ n : ℕ, ℬ n = Submodule.span S (ψ '' (𝒜 n : Set A)))
    (hψ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ HomogeneousIdeal.map ψ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜))
    (j : ℤ)
    (η : (tensorPullback (map ψ hψ)).obj (twist 𝒜 j) ⟶ twist ℬ j)
    (hη : ∀ (U : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) (s : Γ(twist 𝒜 j, U))
      (x : map ψ hψ ⁻¹ᵁ U),
      ((η.app (map ψ hψ ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (tensorPullbackSection (map ψ hψ) (twist 𝒜 j) U s)).1 x :
          Localization.AtPrime x.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) =
        Localization.localRingHom _ _ ψ.toRingHom rfl (s.1 ⟨_, x.2⟩).val)
    (n : ℕ) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 n) (hn : 0 < n)
    (W : (Proj ℬ).Opens) (hW : W ≤ basicOpen ℬ (ψ f)) :
    Function.Bijective (η.app W)
